RUN case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
      amd64) mise_arch=x64; mise_sha=6e39ee1ffa926a1f64814efbf1d26c3f617255e2a6ba6152e3c8a5135fa5a35f ;; \
      arm64) mise_arch=arm64; mise_sha=80ad6e9589d3c4483fd67a4a97f07e28330964dde64ca8cad15d5cb56134a54d ;; \
      *) exit 2 ;; \
    esac \
    && curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
      "https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/v${MISE_VERSION}/mise-v${MISE_VERSION}-linux-${mise_arch}" \
      --output /usr/local/bin/mise \
    && echo "${mise_sha}  /usr/local/bin/mise" | sha256sum --check --strict \
    && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/mise
reason: The only pipe feeds a fixed builtin echo into sha256sum --check --strict. sha256sum is the final status-bearing command and rejects empty, malformed or mismatched input. There is no fallible download on the left of the pipe.
The digest-pinned official Node image defines the node account. This build-stage USER is resolved inside that image, not by a host bind-mount account lookup.
The standard root account is needed for the following ownership-preserving COPY operations; the final USER returns to node in the same pinned official image.
The digest-pinned official Node image defines node. The development runtime uses that image account and does not resolve an arbitrary host user name.
